title: Type it the way you'd say it. DealCaddie finds the cash flow.
blurb: Deals: describe your buy box in plain English. DealCaddie underwrites every listing in the market on all 7 strategies, shows the ones that hit your numbers, and emails new matches every morning.

scenes.line: What if the cash-flowing deals came to you?
Just type it the way you'd say it: three-bed under $300K in Cleveland that cash-flows $200 a month.
DealCaddie turns that into a buy box: the market, price, beds and your cash-flow target.
Then it underwrites every listing in the market on all seven strategies. {hits} hit your numbers.
